Work.title: Work
Work.description: Six projects, six contexts: SaaS, B2B2C, edtech, consultancy, gaming, and my own startup. The numbers won't impress you, I don't have all of them, and the ones I do don't tell the full story. What I can show you is the reasoning: what the problem was, how I read it, what I decided to leave out and why. That's what you're actually hiring when you hire a senior PM.

Community.framing: Built Valencia's most active product community from zero, because I believed the community already existed, it just needed a real place to meet.
Community.story: I founded Valencia Product Beers to test a simple hypothesis: that a product community already existed in Valencia that genuinely wanted to meet and share, tired of events where someone's always selling something. The goal was to move LinkedIn connections into real ones. Beer is just the icebreaker. It's not my first community, either, before this I co-organized FreemoteHouse, Reset Weekend and NOSOLOENLARED, building spaces for founders and remote workers to actually meet each other.

SideProjects.title: Outside the day job
SideProjects.description: Founder experience (including the failure that taught me the most), published articles, and experiments with new tools, to see what's worth building when nobody's asking for it.
SideProjects.remsoulDescription: Remsoul built technology for large-scale events, extending the reach of marketing campaigns, understanding attendee behavior, and flagging risk situations early enough to react. It's also the story behind my biggest lesson: the team fell in love with the product and didn't kill it in time.
SideProjects.compruebaHipotecaDescription: A tool to check whether you can realistically afford a mortgage in Spain, model your income, debts and the property price to see the numbers a bank would run, and play with the variables yourself.
SideProjects.articlesPending: titles and links for the articles published in {publication}.
SideProjects.experimentAiDescription: Daily use of Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Replit and Lovable to prototype, debug and ship automations hands-on. It's not a weekend hobby, it's the same toolkit I use in my PM work to validate direction before asking engineering for time.
SideProjects.experimentBrainstormDescription: A Claude skill that runs six different personalities (creative, analytical, the hater, the practical one, the futurist and my mom) through the same topic in three rounds: they pitch ideas, evolve them, then land on a synthesis. I use it when I want to pressure-test an idea from angles I wouldn't cover alone.

About.bio1: Senior Technical Product Manager with 5+ years building and scaling B2B and B2C SaaS products in integration-heavy, partner-facing environments. I lead API-based integrations end to end, translating technical and business requirements into clear specs, then coordinating engineering, data, operations and external partners to ship them.
About.bio2: I'm a daily user of AI tooling, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, to prototype, debug and ship automations myself, not just write specs and hand them off. Discovery isn't a phase, it's a habit, and the best roadmap is the one that kills bad ideas before they cost engineering time.
About.bio3: Outside work, I run Valencia Product Beers, a community I built because I was tired of fake networking events. We meet, we talk product, we drink beer. Simple.

Ask.metaTitle: Ask Me Anything — Carlos Miguel Corada
Ask.title: Chat with me, literally
Ask.description: This chat responds as me: honest, direct, no corporate speak. If you flip on "mom mode", my mom answers instead, with all the warmth and charming confusion that implies.

Chat.welcomeCarlos: Hey. Ask me anything, about product, marketplaces, the community, my failures, or whatever you're curious about. I'll be straight with you.
Chat.welcomeMom: Hello dear! Well, hello to you asking about my son. Ask whatever you want, I know a lot about Carlos, even if I don't always understand everything he does...
Chat.footerCarlos: powered by gemini · responds as carlos, not a generic chatbot
